submittedParameters.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Paint ONE independently hand-drawn native square 1254x1254 transparent RGBA full-body game sprite of this exact celestial musician girl. Single pose, one character, no sheet. Image1=identity and immutable hand ownership, Image2=direction and camera reference, Image3=approved clean bright rounded Daoist chibi hand-painted style; any Image4 is same-direction scale/continuity anchor. Keep purple high bun long hair, gold lotus/pearl crown, violet eyes, ivory-lavender-gold embroidered long sleeves, short tunic over puffy lavender trousers, ivory-purple boots, green waist knot, ONE rigid elongated flat purple-gold qin. Anatomical LEFT supports upper qin, anatomical RIGHT rests/grips lower string face, both hands continuously attached during run. Both shoulders and elbows rotate naturally with stride while retaining grips, no hand swap. Two arms and two legs only, coherent hips/knees/ankles and boot toes; do not hide all feet under skirt. Preserve actual alpha, translucent ribbons. Full silhouette within clear margins. Same global head/body size and camera, no zoom, no individual bbox fit or grounded recentering. Virtual canvas 1024 root(512,942), floor92%canvas. Head crown around13%canvas in contact phase and boots near92%, with small true run bob. STRICT SOUTH facing straight TOWARD VIEWER, front view, symmetric violet eyes, no sideways turn. Anatomical RIGHT arm/leg on SCREEN LEFT; LEFT arm/leg on SCREEN RIGHT. LEFT hand SCREEN RIGHT supports upper qin end at upper-right; RIGHT hand SCREEN LEFT lower strings at lower-left. Trace both arm chains and never swap. FRAME S12 of16, cycle cadence to review at640/720/800ms: LEFT TOE PUSH OFF, opposite of right-push04. Image4 is actual left-support/right-passing reference. SCREEN RIGHT anatomical LEFT leg extends backward/down under hip, left heel raised and ONLY front toe contact around(x735,y1200). SCREEN LEFT anatomical RIGHT thigh drives FORWARD toward viewer with knee bent70degrees, large RIGHT boot held HIGH at(x505,y1030) showing some sole. Distinct high screenLEFT right boot, low screenRIGHT left toe. Hip rising from left support, left shoulder comes forward opposite raised right knee, right shoulder recedes; both original qin grips attached. Same straight frontal camera and head/body scale. Hair, sleeves and ribbons lag naturally and change with gait. No background, ground, shadow, text, border, particles, glow, motion lines, trails, extra props. Highest visual finish; project target2.5Sunburst/max is host-managed, not a submitted model parameter.
